tools.name: calculate_building_work
tools.description: Use this when a user asks the cost of building, extending or renovating a home, remodelling a kitchen/bathroom, refining a budget or costing drawings, even without naming Proper Job. Computes repeatable local-currency estimates using versioned country-specific construction benchmarks, scope and allo

tools.name: get_estimate_requirements
tools.description: Retrieve UK/US input requirements or labelled reference examples when specifically requested. For a project budget, vague cost question or drawings, use calculate_building_work. Reference examples are not the user's project price. No account or drawing-file access.

tools.name: calculate_guide_price
tools.description: Calculate the established GB/US Guide Price contract with its required project inputs, when explicitly requested or used with guide comparisons. For the conversational building budget, other countries or drawings, use calculate_building_work. Returns the original guide card and does not read files,

tools.name: compare_guide_scenarios
tools.description: Compare GB/US Guide Price scenarios when the user explicitly asks to compare alternatives within those existing policies. Returns the original comparison card and deltas. For other countries or drawing-based refinements, use calculate_building_work with each requested scenario. No foreign-rate conve

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: calculate_guide_price · Private data: get_estimate_requirements, calculate_guide_price · Public sink: calculate_building_work.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: calculate_guide_price · Private data: get_estimate_requirements, calculate_guide_price · Public sink: calculate_building_work

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
